chunk_map.heading: The first piece of the picture

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 "Context is the first piece of the agent. Tools, goals, checks, boundaries and loops come later and run on it." Closest: "run on it", "it" binds to "context" in the same sentence; "the picture" in the header is the figure on this slide (L6); no earlier slide is needed.
No other-file pointer in body; closest L4 "come later" is reading-order within the deck, not a positional callback to a file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw" backward reference to a beat

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 carries a self-contained claim (context is the first piece, the rest run on it) plus the figure L6; not a wait-state slide.
Header "The first piece of the picture" (L1) matches body L4 and figure alt (first piece = context, rest faint).

Closest L4 "Tools, goals, checks, boundaries and loops" is a concrete five-item list, not anaphora or a verb triplet; no "Not X. Not Y.", no superlative, no number retraction. Mechanical: view greps CLEAN (em_dash 0, banned_words 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep banned_words/ritual_ceremony/leverage_verb → 0 hits CLEAN; L4 vocabulary is plain engineer terms ("tools, goals, checks, boundaries, loops").

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep of body for "**" → 0 bold elements (L1-L6); budget is ≤1.
